paragraphs: He is mentioned in the Jerusalem Talmud, Berakhot, chapter 2, halakhah 5.[^1]

notes.text: The stored Guggenheimer Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 2:5 scalar explicitly names Rabbi Yose bar Avun instructing Rabbi Hillel his son-in-law. This supports both title expansions and the relationship direction for this occurrence. The heading's Avin spelling remains distinct from the edition's Avun.
